Phase 3 (rest) clears the state and records now in +28; the first change after it sets the direction (phase 1 -> state 2, phase 2 -> state 1) and arms; the next change fires once and disarms: one report per detent, not every 16 calls.

Step size: dt = now - (+28); if now >= (+28) (no wrap) and dt/2 < 9 the step is g_encoder_accel_table[dt/2] (12, 10, 8, 6, 5, 4, 3, 2, 1), else 1; negated for state 2. now is tick_count() (0xC2617CC0) from the input poll.
